# Altradits

Altradits teaches anyone to use Bitcoin, starting with a free wallet called
Ye₿ente. Start here: https://altradits.com/

## Ye₿ente: the free Bitcoin wallet

- Open a wallet in about a minute, nothing to install: https://altradits.com/yebente#create
- Opening is free. Payments between Ye₿ente wallets are free. Payments out over
  Lightning pay the network's small routing fee. M-Pesa payouts add the payout
  partner's 1 percent fee.
- Ye₿ente is a starter wallet: Altradits holds small amounts for you on its own
  Lightning node, so balances are capped for everyday amounts. When ready, we
  help you move to a wallet only you control, free.
- One 6-digit PIN opens the app and approves every payment. Five wrong PINs
  lock payments. A recovery email plus PIN, or 12 recovery words, bring the
  wallet back on a new phone.

## kTown: sats to M-Pesa for merchants

- A shop prints one QR: https://altradits.com/ktown. Customers pay in sats,
  the merchant receives Kenyan shillings in M-Pesa. kTown holds no money and
  is not a wallet; Tando converts for a 1 percent fee.

## Kazi board: small paid tasks in Kisumu

- A moderated noticeboard: https://altradits.com/kazi. Anyone posts a small
  task; nothing goes public until approved. The poster pays the worker
  directly, peer to peer, in sats or M-Pesa. Kazi holds no money and takes
  no cut. English and Kiswahili.
